error_message_template.description: Default error message template for validation failures. Can be overridden per data source. Available variables: {{.SchemaFile}}, {{.Document}}, {{.FullMessage}}, {{.Errors}}, {{.ErrorCount}}. Use {{range .Errors}} to iterate over individual errors.

schema_version.description: Default JSON Schema version to use when not specified in schema document. Supported values: `draft-04`, `draft-06`, `draft-07`, `draft/2019-09`, `draft/2020-12`

document.description: Path to document file to validate (supports .json, .json5, .yaml, .yml, .toml)

error_message_template.description: Template for formatting validation error messages. Available variables: {{.SchemaFile}}, {{.Document}}, {{.FullMessage}}, {{.Errors}}, {{.ErrorCount}}. Use {{range .Errors}} to iterate over individual errors.

force_filetype.description: Force document file type (json, json5, yaml, toml). If not set, type is auto-detected from file extension.

ref_overrides.description: Map of remote schema URLs to local file paths. When a $ref references a URL in this map, the local file will be used instead. This allows offline validation with schemas that reference remote resources.

schema_version.description: JSON Schema version override for this validation (overrides provider default)

valid_json.description: The validated document in canonical JSON format. Only set when validation succeeds. Use jsondecode() to access nested structures.
